Constraint inputs for two structures from `files/`: the 18-conformer Ag complex ensemble (multi-structure
XYZ) and the ORCA optimisation of the Ru complex.

**Files used** (from the repository):

* `files/ensemble.xyz` — 18 conformers of an Ag complex, 168 atoms (comment line = energy)
* `files/opt.out` — ORCA, r²SCAN-3c OptTS Freq (transition state), Ru complex C45H42F3IO2P2Ru

**1. Freeze the Ag centre and three donor atoms** of the first conformer.

```bash
frog-crest files/ensemble.xyz -i 0 4 50 83 -o crest/constrain.inp
```

```text
⚠  WARNING: files/ensemble.xyz contains 18 structures: the first is the reference
✔  Saved reference geometry: crest/ensemble_ref.xyz
ℹ  Constraining 4 atoms of files/ensemble.xyz
✔  Saved CREST constraints: crest/constrain.inp
```

`crest/constrain.inp`:

```text
$constrain
  atoms: 1,5,51,84
  force constant=0.5
  reference=ensemble_ref.xyz
$end
```

`crest/ensemble_ref.xyz` (first 3 lines):

```text
168
Reference from ensemble.xyz
Ag    -0.045590    -0.784564    -0.218938
…
```

* The 0-based indices 0 4 50 83 became `1,5,51,84` (CREST counts from 1).
* `ensemble.xyz` holds 18 structures, so the first one was copied to `crest/ensemble_ref.xyz` (168
  atoms) and the constraint file points to it by name. Run CREST from `crest/`, e.g.
  `crest ensemble_ref.xyz --cinp constrain.inp`.

**2. Freeze the Ru coordination sphere of an ORCA output.**

```bash
frog-crest files/opt.out -i 2 3 36 37 38 39 40 41 -o ru/constrain.inp
```

```text
✔  Saved reference geometry: ru/opt_ref.xyz
ℹ  Constraining 8 atoms of files/opt.out
✔  Saved CREST constraints: ru/constrain.inp
```

`ru/constrain.inp`:

```text
$constrain
  atoms: 3-4,37-42
  force constant=0.5
  reference=opt_ref.xyz
$end
```

`ru/opt_ref.xyz` (first 3 lines):

```text
96
Reference from opt.out
 C     0.429856    -1.709005     2.363578
…
```

* Consecutive atoms are compacted: 2 3 36 37 38 39 40 41 became `3-4,37-42`.
* For an ORCA output the last geometry (96 atoms) is written to `ru/opt_ref.xyz`, which is also a
  convenient starting structure for CREST.
